You know what you mean. Your reader doesn’t.

Your clearest ideas may be buried in jargon, scattered across subject matter experts, or sitting in a draft no one has time to finish.

I find the point, ask the questions that sharpen it, and turn it into content people can follow.

Services

Content that makes your expertise easier to understand.

You don’t need to produce everything. You need the right content for the people you’re trying to reach. I help you decide what to say, where it belongs, and how to make it useful.

Content strategy, messaging & positioning

I develop the content framework that anchors the work. I look closely at your business, brand, experts, market, ideal customers, pain points, and objections, using stakeholder and ideal-customer interviews where possible. From that deep dive, I shape the messaging and positioning, then turn it into a practical roadmap for the content your business needs.

Thought leadership & executive content

I draw out an executive’s point of view, capture the way they think and speak, and help develop the ideas that are not fully formed yet. Through long-form interviews, I shape that thinking into LinkedIn posts, articles, Q&As, and other thought leadership that sounds like them.

Articles & case studies

I handle the full process, from research and interviews through outlining, writing, and editing. I structure articles with SEO, AEO, and GEO in mind, working from a keyword strategy supplied by you or your SEO partner. For case studies, I interview clients to surface the real problem, what changed, and how your product or service helped.

Email campaigns & newsletters

I develop the campaign from end to end: the sequence, topics, copy, and calls to action. The work follows the strategy and messaging we build together, moving readers from one message to the next.

LinkedIn content

I create LinkedIn content for a company page, individual subject-matter experts, or both. Each post grows out of the core messaging, positioning, and campaign behind it, so the content supports what the business is trying to say and sell.

From expertise to content people can use.

You bring the expertise. I bring the questions, structure, and writing that turn it into something people can understand and use.

Understand the work

I learn what you’re building, who needs to understand it, what they care about, and what the content needs to help them see.

Find the point

I sort through the detail, ask the follow-up questions, and find the idea worth building the piece around.

Build the piece

I choose the right format and structure, then turn the material into a clear, purposeful piece in your voice.

Refine and finish

We review for accuracy, clarity, and usefulness, then leave you with finished content ready to publish and put to work.

About me

I’m Sharon J. Rehana.

I’m a trained journalist and B2B content strategist and writer. My career began in magazine journalism. Since then, I’ve spent years working with executives and subject matter experts to make complex ideas clear.

My work has taken me from concrete and plumbing to associations, SaaS, and technology. The subject changes; my job is to learn it quickly, ask better questions, and make it clear.

I bring curiosity, patience, and editorial judgment to every project. I know how to enter an expert’s world without pretending to be the expert, ask the follow-up question, and shape what I learn into clear, credible content that sounds like the person behind it.
